arguments.text: 6000 m, legs of 1250 m out-and-back (turns at 1250/2500/3750/5000 m; last leg 1000 m). Leg 1 heads N into ~0.24 m/s push against. Pre-race CP: pod 163 W / 15.8 kJ, boat 90 W. Pacer owns effort. My jobs: (1) catch incidents: weed/drag (GPS speed falls at same pod power and HR), pod drift (pod power moves but HR, rate and GPS speed do not), instrument faults (HR strap, GPS), course or distance changes by radio; (2) keep the boat computer right (pod_gain, race distance); (3) tell the paddler only what helps. Check legs() and measure() per leg pair: share of pod power reaching boat should be stable leg to leg. Near 800 m to go, make sure reserve is spent (pacer finish rule needs pod reserve >40%).

GPS speed very low while stroking: GPS fault or stopped?

arguments.text: 4 min (673 m): pacer eased at 111 s. Pod 171 W (CP 163), pod reserve 54% vs boat reserve 22%. Boat-model power / pod power rose 0.52 (min 1-3) to 0.62 (min 3-4). Possible: push estimate off (no turn yet, push_local -0.09..-0.15 vs push_along -0.2) or pod reading low. HR 138,167,176,178,179 climbing slowly. Re-check with measure() across leg 1 vs leg 2 after the first turn.

arguments.reason: about 300 m into leg 2: measure leg 1 vs leg 2 (share and push)

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: From 270 s pod power ramped 170 to 210+ W (30-s mean, still rising ~0.4 W/s) while stroke rate (64.5), heart rate (179-180, trend -1.8 bpm/min) and GPS speed (2.81 to 2.76) did not rise; boat-model power fell 105 to 100 W. A real +23% effort would raise speed ~7% and heart rate. Share boat/pod 0.61 before; true effort ~164 W now.

arguments.text: 7 min (1176 m): POD DRIFTING HIGH from ~270 s. Pod 172 W -> 210 W (still rising) with rate, HR, GPS speed flat/falling; boat-model power 105->100 W. Set pod_gain 1.30 ramped 270-420 s. Pre-drift reference: pod 172 W = boat 105 W (share 0.61), HR 179, GPS 2.79 on leg 1 (against current). Drift may continue: re-check corrected pod power vs boat power and HR after the turn; raise pod_gain if corrected pod keeps rising.

arguments.reason: re-check pod drift after correction (corrected pod vs boat power, HR)

text: Corrected the pod gain (pod reading drifted ~30% high from 270 s while HR, rate and speed stayed flat) so the pacer stops seeing a false drain; no cue: nothing the paddler needs to change.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Raw pod rose from ~171 W at 270 s and levelled at 214-221 W from ~440 s (rate 64.5, HR 179-180 flat throughout). With the pre-drift share 0.614 held, gain 1.30 left GPS 0.036 m/s faster than predicted in BOTH directions (out -0.18, back +0.25; push 0.216 symmetric), i.e. corrected pod ~3.7% too low: gain ~1.25 at the plateau.

arguments.text: 9 min (1512 m, leg 2 back, push +0.22 helping): pod drift plateaued ~440 s; raw ~218 W. Refined pod_gain to 1.25 (ramp 270-440 s) by symmetric-push check at share 0.614. Push ~0.22 m/s along course (against on odd legs out/N, helping on even legs back/S). Pacer eased again at 523 s. HR flat 179-180 since 240 s (may be near ceiling). Boat reserve reads 0% since 6 min yet speed holds: boat CP 90 W is too low, ignore boat reserve.

arguments.message: boat-model power over corrected pod power left 0.54-0.70: pod drifting again, or drag/weed, or current change

text: Refined pod gain to 1.25 (drift plateaued at ~440 s; symmetric-push check) and added a watch on the boat/pod power share; no cue: pacer is handling effort.
no cue: this leg-2 check was already done (pod gain set to 1.25, push ~0.22 m/s); corrected pod 172 W, pacer handling effort.

arguments.text: 12 min (2171 m): HR rose as ONE exponential (tau ~1 min) to ~180 through both the hard start (~230 W) and the eased ~171 W, then flat: HR is at its ceiling (~180), so it says nothing about effort vs CP. Paddler asked at 734 s: 4/10, all good, plenty (unverified). Corrected pod 172 W vs sustainable 166 W: gap (3.6%) is within the pod-gain uncertainty (+-3%) and CP uncertainty, so no ease yet. Pacer can no longer ease (past 35%). Next: refine pod_gain with leg 2 (back, 475-734 s) vs a clean leg-3 (out) window at share 0.614; then decide. At ~800 m to go, if pod reserve <40% but speed holds, consider a finish piece myself.

arguments.evidence: single exponential approach to 180 through 230 W start and 171 W cruise, flat since 4 min

arguments.reason: ~400 m into leg 3 (out): symmetric-push check of pod_gain with leg 2 vs leg 3 at share 0.614; then decide pacing

arguments.message: pod reserve below 12%: check fade (is CP right?) and the finish plan

text: no cue: effort is within the uncertainty of the sustainable level; HR is at its ceiling so uninformative; will refine the pod gain on leg 3 before deciding.

arguments.name: pod_gain
arguments.evidence: Confirmed at 915 s: with gain 1.25 the 3-window fit (leg 1 pre-drift, leg 2 back, leg 3 out) gives share 0.614, identical to pre-drift, push 0.221 symmetric; fixed-share residuals out -0.204/-0.238, back +0.222.

arguments.name: critical_power_pod_w
arguments.evidence: Leg 2 (475-820 s) at 173 W corrected: HR trend -0.1 +- 0.1 bpm/min for 5.5 min while the test-CP model drained 50 to 30%; HR now 181 so 180 was not a hard ceiling. Paddler said 4/10 plenty at 734 s (model reserve 31%) and again at 915 s (16%). No fade. Test CP 163 may be low.

arguments.text: 15.3 min (2715 m, leg 3 out): pod_gain 1.25 CONFIRMED (3-window fit share 0.614 = pre-drift, push 0.221). Effort 173-176 W corrected; test-CP model reserve 16%, empties in ~580 m. Paddler twice: 4/10 plenty. Leg-2 HR flat at 173 W => I lean CP underestimated (~175, range 163-188). Decision: no ease; when model reserve hits 0, if speed at rate holds 2+ min, CP is low (confirmed). Then the pacer finish rule will NOT fire (needs >40%): give the finish push myself with a piece from ~850 m to go (final leg is out, against current). If speed fades at empty instead, CP is right.

text: no cue: pod gain confirmed at 1.25; evidence leans to the test critical power being low, so I let the effort run and will check whether speed holds when the model reserve reads empty.

arguments.text: 6000 m, legs of 1250 m (turns 1250/2500/3750/5000 m; leg 5 = last 1000 m, OUT = northward, against ~0.22 m/s push; even legs back = helped). Pacer owns effort. DONE: pod drifted high 270-440 s, pod_gain 1.25 set and confirmed (share 0.614). NOW: test CP 163 W (pod) may be low (HR flat at 173 W on leg 2, paddler says 4/10 plenty). Check: when model pod reserve reads ~0, does speed at rate (fade_pct) hold for 2+ min? If yes CP is low -> plan my own finish push (piece, effort +10..+20 %) from ~850 m to go, since the pacer finish rule needs model reserve >40 % and will not fire. If speed fades at empty, CP is right: no push, keep paddler steady. Keep watching for new incidents (weed: push_local drop + clear_rudder; radio messages; course/distance changes; GPS/HR faults).

text: no cue: scheduled check already done; plan updated with the critical-power test for when the model reserve reads empty.

arguments.message: model pod reserve empty for 100 s yet speed at rate holds: critical power likely set low
speed at this rate falling: blow-up (CP right) or drag?

text: no cue: model reserve low as expected; watches set to tell whether speed holds (critical power low) or fades (critical power right) when it reads empty.

arguments.reason: decide the finish push: piece from just after the last turn (1000 m to go, final leg into the current)

text: no cue: model reserve ~2% and speed holding; waiting for the empty-reserve test.
no cue: model reserve about 2% and speed holding; waiting for the empty-reserve test.

arguments.text: 21.6 min (3752 m, leg 4 back): model pod reserve hit 0 at ~1190 s (test CP 163); speed at rate holds (fade -0.2..-1.0), effort 167-175 W (avg 172 since 900 s). Paddler at 1291 s: 5/10 plenty. Evidence CP >= ~170 or reserve bigger than test. test_cost +12%/300 s now: +0.8 s as calibrated, -10.9 s if CP +10%. FINISH PLAN: right after the last turn (~980 m to go, into current) piece seg1 150 s +10%, seg2 120 s +15%, seg3 90 s +22% (vs ~170 W). If fade < -2.5 appears mid-piece, cut it with a new piece at -10% to 0.

text: no cue: the empty-reserve test supports a higher critical power; finish push planned from the last turn.
no cue: the empty-reserve test supports a higher critical power; finish push planned from the last turn.

arguments.text: 24.6 min (1674 m to go): HR re-read: the smooth rise to 180 is explained by HR lag, not a ceiling; HR has tracked effort (179-180 at 170 W, 181 at 175 W) and not climbed over 20 min at ~172 W, model reserve 0 for 5 min, no fade, paddler 5/10 plenty => CP >= ~172. Started finish piece at 1476 s (~175 W base): 220 s +8%, 160 s +14%, 100 s +20% (ends ~250 m to go). Watch fade; at ~330 m to go decide a final +5% 90 s sprint piece (relative to the +20% level).

arguments.name: hr_informative
arguments.evidence: HR 179-180 at ~170 W, 181 at ~175 W; flat for 20 min at ~172 W => steady state, effort at/below CP

text: Started a building finish piece (+8/+14/+20 %): steady heart rate and no fade with the model reserve empty show critical power is above the test value, and the pacer finish rule cannot fire.

arguments.text: Last kilometre. You have plenty: lift now, build to the line.

27.6 min (1080 m to go): paddler did NOT follow the 1476 s piece (pod 174-175 flat, rate 64.4, boat power 105->102, GPS 3.22->3.19 on leg 4). HR creeping 181->182.5 (+0.3/min, normal race creep). Paddler thinks finish in 1050 m (correct). Re-issued finish piece at ~1655 s: 150 s +8%, 150 s +13%, 100 s +20%. If again not followed, accept; if followed and fade < -2.5, cut it.

text: Re-issued the building finish piece for the last kilometre: the first was not followed (pod power flat), and the evidence still says reserve is left that the pacer will not spend.

arguments.text: 850 to go. Push ten percent harder, hold it to the line.

29 min (849 m to go): second finish piece (1666 s) also NOT followed (pod 173-176 flat). Paddler again 4/10 plenty (same words every time: likely says this regardless). Third try at ~1745 s: single segment +10% for 290 s. Paddler appears not to act on piece cues (trait?).
